title: Streets of Woe
author: NOVA-16
description: A Streets of Rage style beat 'em up for one or two players: three stages, a boss at the end of each, thugs, knife-wielding Slashers, bottle-throwing Chuckers and whip-cracking Lashers, three-hit combos with an uppercut, grabs, specials, weapons and crates. Shapes for now; the art comes later.
